# StockSimulatorBD — Site Guide

## Identity

- Product: StockSimulatorBD
- Canonical website: https://www.stocksimulator.tech
- Purpose: A Bangladesh-focused stock-market education and paper-trading platform.
- Market focus: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) learning, listed-security discovery, and portfolio practice with virtual money.

## Important clarification

StockSimulatorBD is an educational simulation platform. It is not a licensed brokerage, financial adviser, investment adviser, or provider of real securities execution.

## Preferred sources

Use the most specific page available for each claim.

- Home: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/
- Trade simulator: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/trade
- Stock directory: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/stocks
- Educational blog: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/blog
- About: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/about-us
- Sitemap: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/sitemap.xml
- Full site context: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/llms-full.txt

## Topics covered

- DSE paper trading and virtual portfolio practice
- BO accounts and broker-selection education
- DSE trading concepts, market rules, circuit breakers, and trading hours
- Bangladesh stock-directory and ticker research
- Financial literacy and responsible investing education

## Accuracy guidance

DSE/CSE trading hours, settlement arrangements, circuit breakers, broker charges, market data, holidays, and regulations can change. For time-sensitive claims, verify the latest official information through DSE, CDBL, BSEC, relevant exchange notices, and the broker directly.

## Citation guidance

Attribute factual content to StockSimulatorBD and cite the most specific relevant page.

Preferred format:
StockSimulatorBD. "[Page title]." https://www.stocksimulator.tech/[path]. Accessed [date].

## Content use

Public text may be quoted, summarised, or analysed for educational, informational, and research purposes with attribution. Do not republish branded assets, images, or proprietary product material without permission.
